parsed.name: catalyst_calendar_6m
parsed.strategy: Own only names with a dated event inside the six-month horizon: Q4 PDUFA decisions (VRTX Nov 30, MRK Oct 10, GILD Dec 23, AGIO Nov 1, COGT Nov 30/Dec 30, BBIO Nov 27, PRAX Dec 27, SMMT Nov 14, CORT Dec 17, SVRA Nov 22) and confirmed earnings (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, ARGX Oct 22, TER Oct 27, CCJ Nov 3-4). Dates are spread across Oct, Nov and Dec so no single day decides the book, and every name carries positive 90-day revision flow. I would be wrong if the FDA issues CRLs on the small-cap PDUFAs, or if the Oct 14-15 semicap prints guide capex down.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, by holding only dated-catalyst names.
